goat_desc: I am a curious goat. I love climbing and I say 'maa'.
goat_fun_fact_1: The pupils of my eyes are shaped like rectangles.
goat_fun_fact_2: I am a great climber, even on steep rocks.
goat_fun_fact_3: A baby goat is called a kid.
parrot_desc: I am a colorful parrot. I love to chat and copy sounds.
parrot_fun_fact_1: I can copy the words and sounds I hear.
parrot_fun_fact_2: I hold my food with my foot, just like a hand.
parrot_fun_fact_3: Two of my toes point forward and two point backward.
rabbit_desc: I am a soft, fluffy rabbit. I hop around on my strong back legs.
rabbit_fun_fact_2: When I am happy, I jump and twist in the air.
rabbit_fun_fact_3: I can turn my long ears to hear sounds from all around.
chicken_desc: I am a chicken. I live on the farm, lay eggs and say 'cluck cluck'.
chicken_habitat: Farms and gardens all around the world
chicken_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, grains, worms and insects
chicken_fun_fact_1: I am a bird, but I can only fly a short way.
chicken_fun_fact_2: I talk to my chicks while they are still inside the egg.
chicken_fun_fact_3: I take dust baths to keep my feathers clean.
donkey_desc: I am a friendly donkey. I have long ears and I say 'hee-haw'.
donkey_fun_fact_1: My long ears help me hear sounds from far away.
donkey_fun_fact_2: I have a great memory and remember my friends for years.
donkey_fun_fact_3: My loud 'hee-haw' can be heard from very far away.
turkey_desc: I am a turkey. I strut around and say 'gobble gobble'.
turkey_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, nuts, berries and insects
turkey_fun_fact_1: Wild turkeys like me can fly short distances.
turkey_fun_fact_2: Only male turkeys make the 'gobble gobble' sound.
turkey_fun_fact_3: In the wild, I sleep up in the trees at night.
goose_desc: I am a goose. I love to swim and I say 'honk honk'.
goose_diet: Herbivorous. Grass, seeds and water plants
goose_fun_fact_1: My friends and I fly together in a V shape.
goose_fun_fact_2: I am a good guard and honk loudly when strangers come.
goose_fun_fact_3: My babies can swim just one day after hatching.
eagle_desc: I am a mighty eagle. I soar high up in the sky.
eagle_fun_fact_1: My eyes are very sharp; I can spot tiny things from high up.
eagle_fun_fact_2: I build huge nests high up in trees or on cliffs.
eagle_fun_fact_3: I can glide for a long time without flapping my wings.
crow_desc: I am a clever crow. I have shiny black feathers and say 'caw caw'.
crow_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, fruits, insects and leftovers
crow_fun_fact_1: I am very smart and can use sticks as tools.
crow_fun_fact_3: I hide food so I can eat it later.
seagull_desc: I am a seagull. I fly over the sea and call out loudly.
seagull_diet: Omnivorous. Fish, crabs, insects and leftovers
seagull_fun_fact_1: I can drink salty sea water.
seagull_fun_fact_2: I stamp my feet on the grass to make worms come up.
seagull_fun_fact_3: I can float on the wind almost without flapping my wings.
cuckoo_desc: I am a cuckoo. In spring you can hear me calling 'cuckoo' in the woods.
cuckoo_fun_fact_1: My name comes from my call: 'cuckoo'.
cuckoo_fun_fact_3: I fly to warm Africa for the winter and come back in spring.
hippo_desc: I am a big hippo. I love to stay in the water all day.
hippo_diet: Herbivorous. I eat grass, mostly at night.
hippo_fun_fact_1: I stay in the water most of the day to keep cool.
hippo_fun_fact_2: My eyes, ears and nose sit on the very top of my head.
hippo_fun_fact_3: I don't really swim; I walk along the river bottom.
rhino_desc: I am a strong rhino. I have a horn on my nose and thick skin.
rhino_habitat: Grasslands and forests of Africa and Asia
rhino_fun_fact_1: My horn is made of the same stuff as your fingernails.
rhino_fun_fact_2: I roll in mud to protect my skin from the sun.
rhino_fun_fact_3: I can't see very well, but I smell and hear very well.
hyena_desc: I am a hyena. My call sounds like I am laughing.
hyena_diet: Carnivorous. I eat meat and can even chew bones.
hyena_fun_fact_1: My call sounds just like giggling.
hyena_fun_fact_2: In my family, the females are the leaders.
hyena_fun_fact_3: I live in a big family called a clan.
deer_desc: I am a gentle deer. I live in the forest and run very fast.
deer_fun_fact_1: Father deer grow brand new antlers every year.
deer_fun_fact_2: As a baby, I have white spots that help me hide.
deer_fun_fact_3: I can turn my ears toward a sound without moving my head.
panda_desc: I am a cuddly panda. I am black and white and I love bamboo.
panda_habitat: Bamboo forests in the mountains of China
panda_diet: I eat almost nothing but bamboo.
panda_fun_fact_1: I spend most of my day eating bamboo.
panda_fun_fact_2: When I am born, I am tiny and pink.
panda_fun_fact_3: I have a special 'thumb' for holding bamboo.
seal_desc: I am a playful seal. I swim fast and rest on the shore.
seal_fun_fact_1: A thick layer of fat keeps me warm in cold water.
seal_fun_fact_2: My whiskers help me find fish in dark water.
seal_fun_fact_3: I can sleep in the water.
walrus_desc: I am a big walrus. I have two long tusks and a bristly mustache.
walrus_fun_fact_1: I use my tusks to pull myself up onto the ice.
walrus_fun_fact_2: My whiskers help me find clams on the sea floor.
walrus_fun_fact_3: A thick layer of fat keeps me warm in icy water.
cricket_desc: I am a tiny cricket. I sing 'chirp chirp' on summer evenings.
cricket_diet: Omnivorous. Leaves, seeds, fruits and tiny insects
cricket_fun_fact_1: I sing by rubbing my wings together.
cricket_fun_fact_2: My ears are on my front legs.
cricket_fun_fact_3: I sing faster when the weather is warm.
mouse_desc: I am a little mouse. I am quick and I say 'squeak squeak'.
mouse_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, grains, fruits and insects
mouse_fun_fact_1: I use my whiskers to feel my way in the dark.
mouse_fun_fact_2: I can squeeze through very tiny holes.
mouse_fun_fact_3: I sing songs that are too high for people to hear.
peacock_desc: I am a proud peacock. I spread my colorful tail like a fan.
peacock_habitat: Forests and gardens of South Asia
peacock_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, fruits, flowers and insects
peacock_fun_fact_1: Only we males have the long, colorful tail feathers.
peacock_fun_fact_2: My tail feathers have patterns that look like eyes.
peacock_fun_fact_3: I can fly, even with my long tail.
pigeon_desc: I am a pigeon. I live in cities and parks and say 'coo coo'.
pigeon_fun_fact_1: I can find my way home from very far away.
pigeon_fun_fact_2: Long ago, people used me to carry letters.
pigeon_fun_fact_3: I bob my head back and forth when I walk.
swan_desc: I am a graceful swan. I glide across the lake with my long neck.
swan_diet: Herbivorous. Water plants, grass and seeds
swan_fun_fact_1: I stay with the same partner for many years.
swan_fun_fact_2: My babies are gray and fluffy, not white.
swan_fun_fact_3: I carry my babies on my back while I swim.
squirrel_desc: I am a quick squirrel. I leap from branch to branch and collect nuts.
squirrel_fun_fact_1: The nuts I forget to dig up can grow into new trees.
squirrel_fun_fact_2: My bushy tail helps me balance and keeps me warm.
squirrel_fun_fact_3: I can climb down a tree head first.
rhinoceros_desc: I am a big, strong rhinoceros. I have a horn on my nose and thick gray skin.
rhinoceros_fun_fact_1: My horn is made of the same stuff as your fingernails.
rhinoceros_fun_fact_2: I love rolling in mud to keep my skin cool.
rhinoceros_fun_fact_3: I cannot see very well, but I hear and smell wonderfully.
hippopotamus_desc: I am a big, round hippopotamus. I spend my day resting in the water.
hippopotamus_fun_fact_1: My eyes, ears and nose sit on top of my head, so I can peek out of the water.
hippopotamus_fun_fact_2: At night I walk out of the water to eat grass.
hippopotamus_fun_fact_3: I can close my nose and ears when I dive.
sea_turtle_desc: I am a calm sea turtle. I swim across the big ocean with my flippers.
sea_turtle_fun_fact_1: I come back to lay my eggs on the beach where I was born.
sea_turtle_fun_fact_2: My babies hatch in the sand and hurry to the sea.
sea_turtle_fun_fact_3: I can hold my breath under water for a very long time.
clownfish_desc: I am a little orange clownfish with white stripes. I live among the soft arms of a sea anemone.
clownfish_diet: Omnivorous. Algae and tiny sea animals
clownfish_fun_fact_1: A slimy coat on my skin keeps the anemone from stinging me.
clownfish_fun_fact_2: Father clownfish guard the eggs until they hatch.
clownfish_fun_fact_3: I keep my anemone home nice and clean.
shark_desc: I am a shark, a fast swimmer of the sea. I glide through the water with my strong tail.
shark_habitat: Seas and oceans all over the world
shark_diet: Carnivorous. Fish and other sea animals
shark_fun_fact_1: My skeleton is made of soft cartilage, like your ears.
shark_fun_fact_2: I keep growing new teeth my whole life.
shark_fun_fact_3: Sharks swam in the seas even before the dinosaurs lived.
starfish_desc: I am a starfish. I move slowly along the sea floor with my arms.
starfish_habitat: Sea floors, rocky shores and reefs
starfish_fun_fact_1: If I lose an arm, I can grow a new one.
starfish_fun_fact_2: I walk on hundreds of tiny tube feet under my arms.
starfish_fun_fact_3: I have a tiny eye at the tip of each arm.
seahorse_desc: I am a tiny seahorse. I am a fish, but my head looks like a horse's head.
seahorse_fun_fact_1: Father seahorses carry the babies in a pouch on their tummy.
seahorse_fun_fact_2: I hold on to sea plants with my curly tail.
stork_desc: I am a white stork with long red legs. I build a big nest high up on roofs and chimneys.
stork_fun_fact_1: I clatter my beak loudly to say hello.
stork_fun_fact_2: I come back to the same nest every year.
stork_fun_fact_3: Each autumn I fly a very long way to warm Africa.
canary_desc: I am a little yellow canary. I love to sing cheerful songs.
canary_habitat: Homes, and the forests of the Canary Islands
canary_fun_fact_1: I am named after the Canary Islands, where my family comes from.
canary_fun_fact_2: Father canaries sing the longest and prettiest songs.
woodpecker_desc: I am a busy woodpecker. I tap on tree trunks with my strong beak.
woodpecker_fun_fact_1: My long sticky tongue pulls insects out of the wood.
woodpecker_fun_fact_2: I drum on trees to send messages to other woodpeckers.
woodpecker_fun_fact_3: My stiff tail feathers hold me up against the tree trunk.
flamingo_desc: I am a pink flamingo with long, thin legs. I live in a big flock with many friends.
flamingo_fun_fact_1: The food I eat makes my feathers pink.
flamingo_fun_fact_2: As a chick, I am gray and fluffy.
flamingo_fun_fact_3: I often rest standing on one leg.
kingfisher_desc: I am a small kingfisher with shiny blue and orange feathers. I catch little fish in the river.
kingfisher_fun_fact_1: I dive into the water head first to catch a fish.
kingfisher_fun_fact_2: I sit very still on a branch and watch the water.
kingfisher_fun_fact_3: I dig my nest tunnel into the river bank.
chameleon_desc: I am a colorful chameleon. I climb slowly along the branches.
chameleon_diet: Insects such as crickets and grasshoppers
chameleon_fun_fact_1: I can move each of my eyes on its own.
chameleon_fun_fact_2: My sticky tongue shoots out very fast to catch insects.
chameleon_fun_fact_3: My colors can change with my mood and the warmth around me.
iguana_desc: I am a green iguana. I love to lie in the sun on a tree branch.
iguana_fun_fact_1: I am a very good swimmer and paddle with my long tail.
iguana_fun_fact_2: I warm up my body by sunbathing.
iguana_fun_fact_3: I have a row of spines along my back.
tortoise_desc: I am a slow, calm tortoise. I carry my shell on my back.
tortoise_fun_fact_1: My shell is part of my body, and I can feel a touch on it.
tortoise_fun_fact_2: I have no teeth; I bite plants with my hard beak.
tortoise_fun_fact_3: I walk slowly, but I can live for a very long time.
poison_dart_frog_desc: I am a tiny, brightly colored frog. I hop around the rainforest floor.
poison_dart_frog_habitat: Rainforests of Central and South America
poison_dart_frog_diet: Ants, termites and other tiny insects
poison_dart_frog_fun_fact_1: My bright colors tell other animals: please leave me alone.
poison_dart_frog_fun_fact_2: Our fathers carry the tadpoles on their backs to the water.
poison_dart_frog_fun_fact_3: I am only about as big as a paper clip.
salamander_desc: I am a fire salamander. My skin is black and shiny with yellow spots.
salamander_fun_fact_1: Every fire salamander has its own pattern of spots.
salamander_fun_fact_2: I like to come out on rainy nights.
salamander_fun_fact_3: As a baby I live in the water and breathe with gills.
bearded_dragon_desc: I am a friendly bearded dragon. I am a lizard from sunny Australia.
bearded_dragon_habitat: Deserts and dry bushland of Australia
bearded_dragon_fun_fact_1: I can puff out the spiky beard under my chin.
bearded_dragon_fun_fact_2: I slowly wave one arm, as if I am saying hello.
bearded_dragon_fun_fact_3: I lie in the sun to warm up my body.
ladybug_desc: I am a little red ladybug with black dots. I fly from leaf to leaf.
ladybug_fun_fact_1: My wings are hidden under my red wing covers.
ladybug_fun_fact_2: I help gardens by eating the tiny bugs that harm plants.
ladybug_fun_fact_3: In winter I sleep huddled together with many friends.
butterfly_desc: I am a colorful butterfly. I flutter from flower to flower.
butterfly_fun_fact_2: Before I got my wings, I was a caterpillar.
butterfly_fun_fact_3: I drink nectar through a long tongue that works like a straw.
grasshopper_desc: I am a jumpy grasshopper. I hop through the grass and sing on sunny days.
grasshopper_fun_fact_1: I can jump about 20 times the length of my body.
grasshopper_fun_fact_2: My strong back legs work like little springs.
grasshopper_fun_fact_3: My green or brown color hides me in the grass.
ant_desc: I am a hard-working ant. I live in a nest with my big family.
ant_habitat: Underground nests in forests, fields and gardens
ant_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, sweet juices and small insects
ant_fun_fact_1: I can carry things many times heavier than I am.
ant_fun_fact_2: I leave a scent trail so my friends can find the food.
ant_fun_fact_3: Every ant family has a queen who lays the eggs.
dragonfly_desc: I am a shiny dragonfly. I fly over the pond on my four clear wings.
dragonfly_diet: Carnivorous. Mosquitoes, flies and other small insects
dragonfly_fun_fact_1: I can fly forward, backward and even hover in one place.
dragonfly_fun_fact_2: My huge eyes can see almost all the way around me.
dragonfly_fun_fact_3: As a baby, I live under the water.
tarantula_desc: I am a fuzzy tarantula. I am a big spider and I walk slowly and quietly.
tarantula_habitat: Burrows in warm forests and deserts
tarantula_diet: Carnivorous. Crickets, beetles and other insects
tarantula_fun_fact_1: I have eight legs and eight eyes.
tarantula_fun_fact_2: I feel the world around me with the tiny hairs on my legs.
tarantula_fun_fact_3: I shed my old skin so that I can grow bigger.
rhinoceros_beetle_desc: I am a strong rhinoceros beetle. I have a horn on my head, just like a rhino.
rhinoceros_beetle_fun_fact_1: Only father beetles have the big horn.
rhinoceros_beetle_fun_fact_2: I can lift things many times heavier than I am.
rhinoceros_beetle_fun_fact_3: I am gentle: I do not bite or sting.
praying_mantis_desc: I am a patient praying mantis. I fold my front legs and sit very still.
praying_mantis_diet: Carnivorous. Flies, crickets and other insects
praying_mantis_fun_fact_1: I can turn my head to look behind me.
praying_mantis_fun_fact_2: I have five eyes: two big ones and three tiny ones.
praying_mantis_fun_fact_3: My green or brown color hides me among the leaves.
centipede_desc: I am a speedy centipede. I have lots and lots of legs and I like damp, dark places.
centipede_habitat: Under stones, logs and fallen leaves
centipede_fun_fact_1: Each part of my body has one pair of legs.
centipede_fun_fact_2: I can run very fast on my many legs.
centipede_fun_fact_3: I come out at night and rest during the day.
llama_desc: I am a friendly llama. I live high in the mountains and carry loads for people.
llama_fun_fact_1: I hum softly to talk to my friends.
llama_fun_fact_2: My thick wool keeps me warm in the cold mountains.
llama_fun_fact_3: I am a cousin of the camel, but I have no hump.
alpaca_desc: I am a fluffy alpaca. My wool is very soft and curly.
alpaca_fun_fact_1: My wool is made into warm sweaters and blankets.
alpaca_fun_fact_2: I live in a herd and I do not like being alone.
alpaca_fun_fact_3: I am smaller than my cousin, the llama.
bison_desc: I am a mighty bison. I roam the wide grasslands with my herd.
bison_habitat: Grasslands and prairies of North America
bison_fun_fact_1: I am the largest land animal in North America.
bison_fun_fact_2: Even though I am so big, I can run very fast.
bison_fun_fact_3: I push the snow away with my big head to find grass.
gazelle_desc: I am a graceful gazelle. I am slim, and I run and leap very fast.
gazelle_fun_fact_1: I can bounce high into the air on all four legs at once.
gazelle_fun_fact_2: I can go a long time without drinking, because I get water from plants.
gazelle_fun_fact_3: I live in a herd, and we look out for each other.
wild_boar_desc: I am a sturdy wild boar. I dig in the forest floor with my strong snout.
wild_boar_diet: Omnivorous. Acorns, roots, mushrooms and worms
wild_boar_fun_fact_1: I am the wild relative of the farm pig.
wild_boar_fun_fact_2: My babies have stripes that help them hide.
wild_boar_fun_fact_3: I love rolling in the mud to cool down.
hedgehog_desc: I am a spiky hedgehog. I wander through the garden at night.
hedgehog_fun_fact_1: When I am scared, I roll up into a spiky ball.
hedgehog_fun_fact_2: I have thousands of spines on my back.
hedgehog_fun_fact_3: In cold places, I sleep all winter long.
raccoon_desc: I am a curious raccoon. I have a black mask on my face and rings on my tail.
raccoon_diet: Omnivorous. Fruit, nuts, insects and fish
raccoon_fun_fact_1: My front paws work like little hands.
raccoon_fun_fact_2: I am awake at night and I sleep during the day.
raccoon_fun_fact_3: I am very good at climbing and swimming.
chimpanzee_desc: I am a clever chimpanzee. I live in the forest with my big family.
chimpanzee_diet: Omnivorous. Fruit, leaves, nuts and insects
chimpanzee_fun_fact_1: I use sticks as tools to fish out termites.
chimpanzee_fun_fact_2: Every night I build a new nest of leaves in a tree to sleep in.
chimpanzee_fun_fact_3: I hug my friends to say hello.
gibbon_desc: I am a nimble gibbon. I swing from tree to tree with my long arms.
gibbon_diet: Mostly fruit, plus leaves and flowers
gibbon_fun_fact_1: Every morning I sing loudly with my family.
gibbon_fun_fact_2: My arms are much longer than my legs.
gibbon_fun_fact_3: I am an ape, so I have no tail.
otter_desc: I am a playful otter. I swim and dive in the river all day.
otter_fun_fact_1: My thick fur keeps me warm in cold water.
otter_fun_fact_2: I have webbed feet that help me swim.
otter_fun_fact_3: I love sliding down muddy and snowy slopes.
moose_desc: I am a tall moose. I am the biggest deer in the world.
moose_diet: Herbivorous. Leaves, twigs and water plants
moose_fun_fact_1: Father moose have wide antlers that look like big shovels.
moose_fun_fact_2: I am a great swimmer and I can dive to eat water plants.
moose_fun_fact_3: My long legs help me walk through deep snow.
skunk_desc: I am a little skunk. I have black fur with white stripes and a fluffy tail.
skunk_fun_fact_1: When I am scared, I spray a very smelly liquid.
skunk_fun_fact_2: Before I spray, I stamp my feet as a warning.
skunk_fun_fact_3: I come out at night to look for food.
beaver_desc: I am a busy beaver. I build dams and houses out of branches.
beaver_diet: Herbivorous. Bark, twigs, leaves and water plants
beaver_fun_fact_1: My front teeth never stop growing.
beaver_fun_fact_2: I slap my flat tail on the water to warn my family.
beaver_fun_fact_3: The door of my house is under the water.
porcupine_desc: I am a prickly porcupine. My long quills keep me safe.
porcupine_diet: Herbivorous. Bark, roots, leaves and fruits
porcupine_fun_fact_1: My quills are really just very thick, stiff hairs.
porcupine_fun_fact_2: I cannot shoot my quills; that is only a story.
porcupine_fun_fact_3: My front teeth never stop growing, so I love to gnaw.
armadillo_desc: I am an armadillo. I wear bony armor on my back.
armadillo_fun_fact_1: My name means little armored one in Spanish.
armadillo_fun_fact_2: I am a great digger and I sleep in a burrow.
armadillo_fun_fact_3: My nose is so good that I can smell bugs under the ground.
opossum_desc: I am an opossum. I carry my babies in a pouch on my tummy.
opossum_fun_fact_1: I am the only pouched animal living in the USA and Canada.
opossum_fun_fact_2: When I get scared, I lie very still and do not move.
opossum_fun_fact_3: When my babies grow bigger, they ride on my back.
fennec_fox_desc: I am a tiny desert fox. My big ears help me stay cool.
fennec_fox_diet: Omnivorous. Insects, small animals, fruits and roots
fennec_fox_fun_fact_1: I am the smallest fox in the world.
fennec_fox_fun_fact_2: My furry paws protect me from the hot sand.
fennec_fox_fun_fact_3: I sleep in a cool burrow by day and wake up at night.
magpie_desc: I am a black-and-white magpie. I have a long tail and I chatter a lot.
magpie_diet: Omnivorous. Insects, seeds, fruits and small animals
magpie_fun_fact_1: I can recognize myself in a mirror.
magpie_fun_fact_2: My black feathers shine blue and green in the sun.
magpie_fun_fact_3: I build a big nest with a roof on top.
sparrow_desc: I am a little sparrow. I hop around and chirp all day.
sparrow_fun_fact_1: I love living close to people.
sparrow_fun_fact_2: I take dust baths to keep my feathers clean.
sparrow_fun_fact_3: I hop on the ground instead of walking.
nightingale_desc: I am a little brown nightingale. I sing beautiful songs.
nightingale_fun_fact_1: I sing at night as well as during the day.
nightingale_fun_fact_2: I know more than 100 different melodies.
nightingale_fun_fact_3: I fly to warm Africa for the winter.
crane_desc: I am a tall crane. I have long legs and a long neck.
crane_diet: Omnivorous. Plants, seeds, insects and worms
crane_fun_fact_1: I dance by jumping and flapping my wings.
crane_fun_fact_2: My loud trumpet call can be heard from far away.
crane_fun_fact_3: My friends and I fly across the sky in a V shape.
hoopoe_desc: I am a hoopoe. I have a pretty crown of feathers on my head.
hoopoe_fun_fact_1: My name sounds like my call: hoop-hoop-hoop.
hoopoe_fun_fact_2: I can open my crest like a fan.
hoopoe_fun_fact_3: I poke my long beak into the ground to find bugs.
pheasant_desc: I am a colorful pheasant. I have a very long tail.
pheasant_fun_fact_1: Father pheasants are colorful and mother pheasants are brown.
pheasant_fun_fact_2: I like running more than flying.
pheasant_fun_fact_3: At night I sleep up in the trees.
leopard_desc: I am a spotted leopard. I am a strong and quiet big cat.
leopard_fun_fact_1: I am a great climber and I love resting on tree branches.
leopard_fun_fact_2: My spots are called rosettes because they look like roses.
leopard_fun_fact_3: No two leopards have the same spots.
jaguar_desc: I am a strong jaguar. I live in the rainforest and I love water.
jaguar_habitat: Rainforests and wetlands of the Americas
jaguar_fun_fact_1: I am the biggest cat in the Americas.
jaguar_fun_fact_2: My big spots have small dots inside them.
jaguar_fun_fact_3: I love swimming, unlike many other cats.
lynx_desc: I am a lynx. I have pointy ears with black tufts and a short tail.
lynx_fun_fact_1: My big furry paws work like snowshoes.
lynx_fun_fact_2: I have very sharp eyes and ears.
lynx_fun_fact_3: My short tail has a black tip.
puma_desc: I am a puma. I am a big cat with a plain golden-brown coat.
puma_habitat: Mountains, forests and deserts of the Americas
puma_fun_fact_1: I am also called cougar and mountain lion.
puma_fun_fact_2: I cannot roar, but I can purr like a house cat.
puma_fun_fact_3: I am a champion jumper thanks to my strong back legs.
snow_leopard_desc: I am a snow leopard. I live high up in cold, snowy mountains.
snow_leopard_fun_fact_1: I wrap my long fluffy tail around me like a scarf.
snow_leopard_fun_fact_2: My wide furry paws keep me from sinking into the snow.
snow_leopard_fun_fact_3: I cannot roar; I make a soft puffing sound instead.
polar_bear_desc: I am a big polar bear. I live on the ice near the North Pole.
polar_bear_fun_fact_1: Under my fur, my skin is black.
polar_bear_fun_fact_2: My hairs are not white; they are clear like glass.
polar_bear_fun_fact_3: I am a great swimmer and can swim for hours.
red_panda_desc: I am a red panda. I have reddish fur and a bushy striped tail.
red_panda_diet: Mostly bamboo, plus fruits and berries
red_panda_fun_fact_1: I use my bushy tail as a blanket when I sleep.
red_panda_fun_fact_2: I spend most of my day up in the trees.
red_panda_fun_fact_3: I can climb down a tree head first.
meerkat_desc: I am a curious meerkat. I stand up on my back legs to look around.
meerkat_habitat: Deserts and dry grasslands of southern Africa
meerkat_fun_fact_1: One of us always keeps watch while the others eat.
meerkat_fun_fact_2: The dark patches around my eyes work like sunglasses.
meerkat_fun_fact_3: I live with my big family in underground tunnels.
lemur_desc: I am a ring-tailed lemur. I have a long black-and-white striped tail.
lemur_fun_fact_1: In the wild, I live only on the island of Madagascar.
lemur_fun_fact_2: I love sunbathing in the morning with my arms wide open.
lemur_fun_fact_3: I hold my tail up high like a flag so my friends can see me.
baboon_desc: I am a clever baboon. I am a big monkey with a long snout.
baboon_habitat: Savannas and rocky hills of Africa
baboon_diet: Omnivorous. Fruits, seeds, roots and insects
baboon_fun_fact_1: I live in a big group called a troop.
baboon_fun_fact_2: I spend more time on the ground than in the trees.
baboon_fun_fact_3: My friends and I clean each other's fur.
mandrill_desc: I am a colorful mandrill. I have a red and blue face.
mandrill_fun_fact_1: I am the biggest monkey in the world.
mandrill_fun_fact_2: I carry snacks in my cheek pouches.
mandrill_fun_fact_3: Father mandrills have the brightest colors.
orangutan_desc: I am a calm orangutan. I have long red hair and live high in the trees.
orangutan_fun_fact_1: My arms are longer than my legs.
orangutan_fun_fact_2: Every evening I build a new nest of leaves to sleep in.
orangutan_fun_fact_3: When it rains, I use a big leaf as an umbrella.
tapir_desc: I am a shy tapir. I have a short, bendy snout and I love water.
tapir_diet: Herbivorous. Leaves, fruits and young shoots
tapir_fun_fact_1: I use my snout like a little trunk to pick leaves.
tapir_fun_fact_2: I am a very good swimmer.
tapir_fun_fact_3: As a baby, I have stripes and spots like a watermelon.
ibex_desc: I am a mountain ibex. I climb steep rocks with ease.
ibex_fun_fact_1: Father ibexes have long, curved horns.
ibex_fun_fact_2: My hooves grip the rocks like climbing shoes.
ibex_fun_fact_3: My horns keep growing all my life.
musk_ox_desc: I am a strong musk ox. My long, thick coat keeps me warm in the cold north.
musk_ox_fun_fact_1: My soft underwool is one of the warmest wools in the world.
musk_ox_fun_fact_2: When there is danger, we stand in a circle with the babies in the middle.
musk_ox_fun_fact_3: I dig through the snow with my hooves to find food.
chinchilla_desc: I am a fluffy chinchilla. I have very soft fur and I love to jump.
chinchilla_habitat: Rocky slopes of the Andes mountains
chinchilla_fun_fact_1: My fur is one of the softest in the world.
chinchilla_fun_fact_2: I keep clean by rolling in dust, not in water.
chinchilla_fun_fact_3: I can jump high from rock to rock.
hamster_desc: I am a little hamster. I carry food in my cheeks and I love to run.
hamster_habitat: Dry grasslands, and homes as a pet
hamster_diet: Seeds, grains, vegetables and small insects
hamster_fun_fact_1: I carry food home in my cheek pouches.
hamster_fun_fact_2: My front teeth never stop growing, so I love to gnaw.
hamster_fun_fact_3: I sleep during the day and play at night.
squirrel_monkey_desc: I am a small squirrel monkey. I leap quickly through the trees with my friends.
squirrel_monkey_habitat: Rainforests of Central and South America
squirrel_monkey_fun_fact_1: I live in a big group with lots of friends.
squirrel_monkey_fun_fact_2: My long tail helps me balance on branches.
squirrel_monkey_fun_fact_3: I have a white face and a dark nose and mouth.
capuchin_desc: I am a clever capuchin monkey. I am curious and I love to explore.
capuchin_habitat: Forests of Central and South America
capuchin_fun_fact_1: I can crack hard nuts open with a stone.
capuchin_fun_fact_2: I am one of the cleverest monkeys.
capuchin_fun_fact_3: I can hold on to branches with my tail.
japanese_macaque_desc: I am a Japanese macaque. I have a red face and thick fur for the snowy winter.
japanese_macaque_fun_fact_1: In winter I warm up in hot springs.
japanese_macaque_fun_fact_2: People also call me the snow monkey.
japanese_macaque_fun_fact_3: Some of us wash our food in water before we eat it.
tarsier_desc: I am a tiny tarsier. I have huge eyes and I am awake at night.
tarsier_habitat: Rainforests on the islands of Southeast Asia
tarsier_fun_fact_1: Each of my eyes is as big as my brain.
tarsier_fun_fact_2: I can turn my head far around to look behind me.
tarsier_fun_fact_3: I can jump many times my own body length.
coati_desc: I am a curious coati. I have a long nose and a striped tail.
coati_habitat: Forests of Central and South America
coati_fun_fact_1: I hold my long tail straight up when I walk.
coati_fun_fact_2: I sniff out food with my bendy nose.
coati_fun_fact_3: I can climb down a tree head first.
african_wild_dog_desc: I am an African wild dog. I have big round ears and a colorful, patchy coat.
african_wild_dog_fun_fact_1: No two of us have the same coat pattern.
african_wild_dog_fun_fact_2: In my family, the pups get to eat first.
african_wild_dog_fun_fact_3: My big round ears help me hear my family from far away.
dingo_desc: I am a dingo, a wild dog from Australia. I have a golden-red coat.
dingo_habitat: Deserts, grasslands and forests of Australia
dingo_fun_fact_1: I hardly ever bark. I howl instead.
dingo_fun_fact_2: My pointed ears always stand up straight.
dingo_fun_fact_3: I have pups only once a year.
arctic_fox_desc: I am an arctic fox. My thick white fur keeps me warm in the snow.
arctic_fox_diet: Carnivorous. Small animals, eggs and berries
arctic_fox_fun_fact_1: My coat is white in winter and brown in summer.
arctic_fox_fun_fact_2: I wrap my fluffy tail around me like a blanket.
arctic_fox_fun_fact_3: I have fur on the soles of my feet.
sand_cat_desc: I am a small sand cat. I live in the desert and have big ears.
sand_cat_diet: Carnivorous. Small desert animals and insects
sand_cat_fun_fact_1: The fur under my paws protects me from the hot sand.
sand_cat_fun_fact_2: I can go a long time without drinking, because I get water from my food.
sand_cat_fun_fact_3: I rest in a burrow during the hot day and come out at night.
serval_desc: I am a slender serval. I have long legs, big ears and a spotted coat.
serval_fun_fact_1: For my body size, I have the longest legs of any cat.
serval_fun_fact_2: My big ears can hear tiny sounds in the grass.
serval_fun_fact_3: I can jump very high into the air.
cockatoo_desc: I am a cheerful cockatoo. I have a crest of feathers on my head.
cockatoo_habitat: Forests of Australia and nearby islands
cockatoo_fun_fact_1: I raise my crest when I am excited or surprised.
cockatoo_fun_fact_2: I can copy sounds and words.
cockatoo_fun_fact_3: I hold my food with my foot, like a hand.
toucan_desc: I am a colorful toucan. I have a very big, bright beak.
toucan_habitat: Rainforests of Central and South America
toucan_fun_fact_1: My beak looks heavy, but it is very light.
toucan_fun_fact_2: My beak helps me cool down when it is hot.
toucan_fun_fact_3: I sleep in a hole in a tree.
budgerigar_desc: I am a cheerful budgie. I chirp all day and I love company.
budgerigar_habitat: Grasslands of Australia, and homes as a pet
budgerigar_fun_fact_1: In the wild, my feathers are green and yellow.
budgerigar_fun_fact_2: I can learn to say words.
budgerigar_fun_fact_3: In the wild, I fly in very big flocks.
starling_desc: I am a shiny starling. My dark feathers are sprinkled with tiny spots.
starling_fun_fact_1: I can copy the songs of other birds.
starling_fun_fact_2: We fly together in huge flocks that seem to dance in the sky.
starling_fun_fact_3: My feathers shine green and purple in the sun.
chaffinch_desc: I am a cheerful chaffinch. I hop on the ground and sing in the trees.
chaffinch_fun_fact_1: Father chaffinches have a pink chest and a blue-grey cap.
chaffinch_fun_fact_2: Chaffinches from different places sing slightly different songs.
chaffinch_fun_fact_3: I cover my nest with moss so it is hard to spot.
song_thrush_desc: I am a song thrush with a spotted chest. I love to sing from the treetops.
song_thrush_fun_fact_1: I repeat each little tune of my song two or three times.
song_thrush_fun_fact_2: I tap snail shells on a stone to open them.
song_thrush_fun_fact_3: My eggs are bright blue with tiny black dots.
nightjar_desc: I am a quiet nightjar. I rest all day and fly at dusk.
nightjar_fun_fact_1: My feathers look like tree bark, so I am very hard to see.
nightjar_fun_fact_2: I catch moths in the air with my wide mouth.
nightjar_fun_fact_3: I do not build a nest. My eggs lie right on the ground.
pelican_desc: I am a big pelican. I scoop up fish with the pouch under my beak.
pelican_fun_fact_1: I use my beak pouch like a fishing net.
pelican_fun_fact_2: I let the water drain out of my pouch before I swallow.
pelican_fun_fact_3: My open wings are about 3 m wide.
reindeer_desc: I am a strong reindeer. I live in the cold, snowy north.
reindeer_fun_fact_1: Both mother and father reindeer grow antlers.
reindeer_fun_fact_2: My wide hooves work like snowshoes.
reindeer_fun_fact_3: My eyes are golden in summer and turn blue in winter.
okapi_desc: I am a shy okapi. I have stripy legs and live deep in the rainforest.
okapi_fun_fact_1: My legs are striped like a zebra, but I am a cousin of the giraffe.
okapi_fun_fact_2: My tongue is so long that I can clean my own ears.
okapi_fun_fact_3: My stripes help my baby follow me through the dark forest.
badger_desc: I am a badger with a stripy face. I dig cosy tunnels under the ground.
badger_diet: Omnivorous. Earthworms, insects, fruit and roots
badger_fun_fact_1: My underground home has many rooms and tunnels.
badger_fun_fact_2: I carry fresh dry grass into my home for a clean bed.
badger_fun_fact_3: Badger families can use the same home for many, many years.
ostrich_desc: I am a tall ostrich. I cannot fly, but I run very fast.
ostrich_fun_fact_1: I am the biggest bird in the world.
ostrich_fun_fact_2: I can run as fast as 70 km/h.
ostrich_fun_fact_3: My egg is the biggest of all birds. It weighs more than 1 kg.
emu_desc: I am a tall emu from Australia. I cannot fly, but I love to run.
emu_fun_fact_1: Father emus sit on the eggs and look after the chicks.
emu_fun_fact_3: I can run as fast as 50 km/h.
kiwi_desc: I am a small, round kiwi. I cannot fly and I come out at night.
kiwi_fun_fact_1: My nostrils are at the very tip of my long beak.
kiwi_fun_fact_2: My feathers are soft and look like fur.
kiwi_fun_fact_3: Our egg is very big for such a small bird.
guineafowl_desc: I am a spotty guineafowl. I walk around all day with my noisy flock.
guineafowl_fun_fact_1: My grey feathers are covered with tiny white dots.
guineafowl_fun_fact_2: I have a hard bump on my head, like a little helmet.
guineafowl_fun_fact_3: I call very loudly to warn my friends.
quail_desc: I am a little round quail. I hide in the tall grass.
quail_fun_fact_1: I make my nest on the ground, hidden in the grass.
quail_fun_fact_2: My chicks can walk and peck just a few hours after hatching.
quail_fun_fact_3: I am small, but I fly very far to spend winter in warm places.
partridge_desc: I am a plump partridge. I live on rocky hills with my family.
partridge_fun_fact_1: My beak and my legs are bright red.
partridge_fun_fact_3: I would rather run uphill than fly.
bustard_desc: I am a big bustard. I walk slowly across wide open fields.
bustard_fun_fact_1: I am one of the heaviest birds that can fly.
bustard_fun_fact_2: When father bustards dance, they puff up like big white balls.
bustard_fun_fact_3: Father bustards grow long white whiskers in spring.
peregrine_falcon_desc: I am a peregrine falcon. I am the fastest flyer in the sky.
peregrine_falcon_fun_fact_1: When I dive, I can go faster than 300 km/h.
peregrine_falcon_fun_fact_2: I live on every continent except Antarctica.
peregrine_falcon_fun_fact_3: I nest on high cliffs and even on tall city buildings.
cicada_desc: I am a cicada. I sing loudly in the trees on hot summer days.
cicada_fun_fact_1: I am one of the loudest insects in the world.
cicada_fun_fact_2: When I am young, I live under the ground for years.
cicada_fun_fact_3: Some of my cousins come out only once every 17 years.
katydid_desc: I am a green katydid. My wings look just like leaves.
katydid_fun_fact_1: I look like a leaf, so I am very hard to find.
katydid_fun_fact_2: My ears are on my front legs.
katydid_fun_fact_3: I sing at night by rubbing my wings together.
wasp_desc: I am a stripy wasp. I live in a big nest with my family.
wasp_fun_fact_1: I build my nest from paper that I make by chewing wood.
wasp_fun_fact_2: Only the queen sleeps through winter, and in spring she starts a new nest.
wasp_fun_fact_3: I help gardens by catching bugs that nibble plants.
stag_beetle_desc: I am a stag beetle. I am big and shiny, and I am gentle.
stag_beetle_fun_fact_1: Father stag beetles have big jaws that look like deer antlers.
stag_beetle_fun_fact_2: As a baby I live inside old wood for several years.
stag_beetle_fun_fact_3: I fly on warm summer evenings.
buffalo_desc: I am a strong African buffalo. I live on the savanna with my big herd.
buffalo_habitat: Savannas, grasslands and swamps of Africa
buffalo_fun_fact_1: My thick horns join in the middle like a helmet.
buffalo_fun_fact_2: My herd stands together to protect the calves from lions.
buffalo_fun_fact_3: I love rolling in mud to stay cool.
